facts.fact: 军犬恐吓失败——那声低笑来自 Max，跟着的少年是 Bailey
facts.anchor: The instant deep, throaty laughter makes me blush. Is that Max?

facts.fact: Cookie 见到 Max 直接叛变，Max 跪地跟狗打招呼
facts.anchor: Cookie jumps out of my arms and rushes to Max, who drops to his knees to greet him

facts.fact: Max 深夜前来道歉：我今晚是个混蛋
facts.anchor: I wanted to apologise. I was a prick tonight.

facts.fact: Max 自嘲一晚被 Flora 榨出三次道歉，「那一定是个纪录」
facts.anchor: You got three apologies out of me in one evening. That must be a record.

facts.fact: Flora 用他自己的台词反杀：把「你以前叫我爸爸」回敬成「叫错名字很恼人，对吧」
facts.anchor: It’s annoying when people call you by the wrong name, isn’t it?

facts.fact: 年龄揭晓：Max 三十六，Flora 二十三，她自曝约会过更老的
facts.anchor: I’ve dated a lot older than you then.

facts.fact: Max 主动提出介绍队里的整骨医生帮她治头痛，被她以「付不起」挡回
facts.anchor: I’ll get you the number of the osteopath who works for the team.

facts.fact: 章末发现：跟这人斗嘴一晚，头痛竟比任何办法都缓解
facts.anchor: joking with this man has done more for easing my headache than anything else I’ve tried this evening
